metadata.description: YouTube to Blog: an Obsidian vault and Claude Code skill that turn videos into source-grounded blog posts

plugins.name: youtube-to-blog
plugins.description: Queue, fetch, analyze, brief, strategy, write, review and evaluate blog posts from YouTube videos inside an Obsidian vault. Install it in other projects; inside the vault itself the project skill under .claude/skills is already active, so do not enable both there.
